text:
Sam: Heads up — found some odd lines on the March cloud invoice. There's an 'EBS re-pricing adjustment' negative line, but also what looks like duplicate data-transfer charges for asia-southeast1. Net +$48,240 compared to expected. Anyone else seeing this?

Sam: Quick paste from the invoice CSV we exported:
```
RESOURCE,DESCRIPTION,AMOUNT,LINE_ITEM_ID
data-transfer,asia-southeast1->internet,32000.00,li-98765
data-transfer,asia-southeast1->internet (adjustment),32000.00,li-98765-adj
storage,ebs-repricing-adjustment,-15000.00,li-99221
commitment,Reserved GPU discount not applied,35000.00,li-99500
```

Priya: Ack. Can you attach the full CSV or point me to the BigQuery table?

Sam: Uploaded CSV snapshot to gs://redwood-billing/snapshots/1752003456-invoice.csv and GCS ACLs set for finance/cloudops.

Jordan: I can run a raw query against the billing export. On a quick scan the provider's CUR doesn't show duplicates on our project rows — might be a post-export invoice-generation step doing adjustments. I'll run: 
```
bq --project_id=redwood-billing query "SELECT invoice_id, line_item_id, description, amount FROM \\\`billing.dataset.invoice_items\\\` WHERE invoice_id='2025-03-01' AND description LIKE '%data-transfer%'"
```

Mei: Opened a support ticket with the provider: INC-91234. AM acknowledged a "rate reconciliation job" ran and may have created overlapping adjustment lines. I've asked for provisional credit and requested an explanation of why reserved discounts didn't apply.

billing-bot: Support update: INC-91234: "Provisional credit applied: USD 48,240. Final reconciliation ETA 5 business days. Commitment application flagged for engineering review."

Sam: Ok — two separate problems here if true: 1) provider-side double charge/adjustment for data-transfer, 2) our reserved GPU commit discount not applied and causing extra on-demand charges. If the commit wasn't applied, we may owe >$35k. Jordan — can you confirm which SKUs missed the discount?

Jordan: Running a commit vs invoice delta now. Example query I'm using: 
```
SELECT sku, SUM(list_cost) as invoice_cost, SUM(commit_discount) as discount_applied
FROM `billing.dataset.line_items`
WHERE sku LIKE '%nvidia-a100%' AND invoice_month='2025-03'
GROUP BY sku;
```
I'll post the raw CSV diff to the shared folder in a few minutes.

Priya: Also, note that sometimes the provider emits both the original charge and then a separate "adjustment" line (same line_item_id with suffix) and our internal ingestion previously deduped on line_item_id; if the provider changed id scheme the dedupe may miss it and we re-ingest causing local state mismatch. But first look suggests the dup is on the invoice itself.

Sam: Action items for this thread:
- Jordan: pull raw billing export rows and produce per-SKU delta (place in /shared/billing/1752003456/).
- Priya: escalate with AM and ask for formal credit note and GAAP-compliant statement (we need documentation for accounting).
- Mei: track INC-91234 and paste provider updates here.
- Sam: freeze any internal chargebacks for March until we have the reconciled invoice.

billing-bot: Noted — will post ticket updates and remind AM in 48 hours.

Jordan: FYI — I pulled the raw rows. There are duplicated line_item_ids in the provider CSV (they sent both the original and an "adjustment" as separate positive lines instead of a single net line). Snapshot uploaded: /shared/billing/1752003456/line_items_raw.csv. I also extracted missing commit lines: looks like sku "nvidia-a100:40gb" had commit discount missing for 2 invoice periods (2025-02, 2025-03).

Sam: Thanks. If the provider won't reverse, we should request a formal credit and written reconciliation for our auditors. Also confirm whether this leads to any downstream internal cost allocations (we might need to adjust product team chargebacks).

Mei: Provider AM responded: provisional credit applied (matches billing-bot). They also acknowledged a bug in their reconciliation pipeline that caused duplicate positive adjustment lines and a missed commit application. AM expects a full fix and corrected invoice within 3 business days. They committed to a credit note for accounting.

Sam: Good. Keep this thread updated — once final invoice comes in we'll validate and then close. If anything changes or the provider balks, we escalate to legal. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: INC-91234 final update (provisional): "Workaround credit issued; reconciliation in progress. Final invoice expected by 2025-03-10." Will post final doc when available.
